hook.name: V4TaxHook
hook.description: Collects a fixed 5% tax (500 BPS) on buy and sell swaps of registered token pools. In beforeSwap, tax is deducted from the exact-input base-asset amount; in afterSwap, from the unspecified base-asset output. Taxes are minted as ERC-6909 claims to the token contract and recorded via ITaxedDividendToken for dividend distribution.
